svg.text: CIM8Bits Top-Level (2D Mesh of MatVecMulWithMem + ReLU8Bits Tiles)
Architecture sketch: R×C mesh (3×3 shown), N=8, In/Out Reg = 8N = 64 bit, instruction-driven mesh dataflow
ISA: LOAD · MATVEC · RELU · ROUTE · SYNC · JUMP
per-tile or broadcast; sets srcSel / bankSel / reluEn
Mesh link: neighbor Out Reg → this tile's Src Mux; Src Mux picks N / E / S / W / Load per instruction. Edge ports are tied off.
